description: Marks a checklist item done (done=true) or open again (done=false). Use when the user says a task is finished or needs reopening.

item_id.description: From get_checklist or add_checklist_item (the exact item text also works).

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character plan ID. Links without a plan ID (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/when) are unsaved local drafts and are not accepted.
